# ByJTT Design

> ByJTT Design is a practical design system and Studio for people and AI building digital products from August 2026 onward.

## Start here

- [Agent entry point](https://design.byjtt.com/agent.json): canonical machine-readable orientation and workflow.
- [ByJTT Design Standard v0.1](https://design.byjtt.com/standard/): canonical human-readable public standard.
- [Machine-readable standard index](https://design.byjtt.com/standard.json): structured standard discovery surface.

## Product surfaces

- [Design Studio](https://design.byjtt.com/studio): describe a product, direct the design, inspect the result and publish reusable work.
- [Design Contracts](https://design.byjtt.com/contracts/): capture important product and design decisions so they remain clear as work changes.
- [Resource Library](https://design.byjtt.com/library/): reusable work recorded with decisions, evidence and provenance.
- [Research](https://design.byjtt.com/research/): research into user needs, patterns, accessibility and AI design failure modes.
- [Benchmarks](https://design.byjtt.com/benchmarks/): controlled comparisons of design workflows with explicit methodology and limitations.
- [Documentation](https://design.byjtt.com/docs/): product and quality guidance.
- [Agent guidance](https://design.byjtt.com/agents/): practical guidance for agents consuming the standard and contracts.

## Recommended workflow

1. Understand the product goal, users and constraints.
2. Read the relevant Standard guidance.
3. Use a Design Contract when important decisions must remain true.
4. Create or revise the interface in Studio when useful.
5. Check accessibility, responsive behaviour, content, states and implementation reality.
6. Publish reusable work with its decisions and evidence when appropriate.

## Standard principles

- Human purpose before interface polish.
- Evidence before aesthetics.
- Intent over imitation.
- Real conditions are the design.
- Accessible by construction.
- Best solved system first.
- Production is the source of truth.
- Human agency with bounded autonomy.
- Provider independence.
- Provenance by default.

## AI and agent state model

Where applicable, distinguish suggested, generated, inspected, verified, executed and human-approved states. Material autonomous actions should expose scope, rationale, evidence, uncertainty, permission boundaries and reversibility appropriate to risk.

## Evidence

Distinguish observed evidence, inference and hypothesis. Generated output and heuristic review are not automatically verified evidence.

## Source of truth

`STANDARD.md` is the canonical public standard. `PRODUCT.md`, `DESIGN.md`, requirements, research, benchmarks and Design Contracts provide supporting context. Public pages and machine-readable resources should expose or index this source rather than silently redefine it.
